result.title: Variational Optimal Control for Diffusion Guidance
result.summary: We present a variational control framework that connects sampling-time guidance and reward-based model adaptation through a shared Jacobian pullback. Starting from terminal reward maximization with a path-space KL penalty, the Gibbs variational principle and Doob transform yield a correction to the generative dynamics. A local denoising approximation exposes the pullback that transports output preferences to the controlled variable. This construction gives Variational Optimal Guidance (VOG) in state space and extends to Distilled Variational Optimal Control (DVOC) by amortizing locally improved endpoints into model parameters. The resulting controls share a local variational rule: VOG acts through the denoising Jacobian, while DVOC realizes the parameter pullback by endpoint distillation. Under a linear MMSE model, VOG's exact correction lies in the data subspace. On ImageNet, VOG reduces DiT-XL/2 FID from 2.27 to 2.04 at 250 sampling steps and from 7.58 to 4.44 at 25 steps. After 20 updates on Z-Image-Turbo, DVOC improves HPSv3++ and four held-out evaluator scores over the untrained model, with the highest corresponding means among the trained methods compared. These results connect inference-time control and reward adaptation through a common geometric principle.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出变分最优控制框架，用共享的 Jacobian pullback 把采样期引导与基于奖励的模型适配联系起来：VOG 在状态空间做引导修正，DVOC 通过端点蒸馏把局部改进摊入模型参数，并在 ImageNet FID 与 Z-Image-Turbo 评测分数上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属图像扩散引导，但其「推理期控制 vs. 蒸馏进参数」的统一表述及用 Jacobian pullback 回传输出偏好的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态控制与奖励驱动轨迹训练之间的贡献分配与信用回传问题。
